surface_value: Central (or thymic) tolerance defects are important and probably essential contributors to spontaneous autoimmune disease. T cells with high affinity for self-antigen escape thymic deletion due to a mutation in the SH2 domain of ZAP-70, leading to low TCR signaling capacity and subsequent development of rheumatoid arthritis.
